{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Bats}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Albino bat |image = [[File:Albino bat.png]] |release = [[4 July]] [[2006]] |update = Trouble Brewing |members = Yes |combat = 52 |size = 2 |examine = It's all white by me. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 7 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 35 |slayxp = 33 |cat = Bats |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 33 |att = 57 |str = 57 |def = 30 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Air |elementalweaknesspercent = 40 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 1039 }} '''Albino bats''' are animals found in the [[Mos Le'Harmless Cave]]. They are aggressive and may be a nuisance to players fighting [[cave horror]]s; however, they are fairly easy to kill due to their low hitpoints, so players with full [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's armour]] may choose to use them as a means of healing. They can be killed for '[[bat]]' [[Slayer]] assignments and give the second highest experience for any enemy in this category next to [[death wing]]s, but this is not recommended as they are only worth 1 experience point more than [[giant bat]]s, which have a much lower combat level and are easier to find.
